info.title: gff-hab API
info.description: Generated from the Go types in package api. Do not edit. See docs/specs/hab-logic-api.md.

methods.name: hab.hello
methods.summary: First request on a control connection: agree a revision (spec 3.2).

params.name: label
params.description: Human label, such as phone or desk.

params.name: min_revision
params.description: Oldest API revision the client accepts.

params.name: peer
params.description: Set by a hab that dials another hab (client.kind hab): who is calling (mesh.md 3.2).

params.name: reconnect_token
params.description: Token from an earlier welcome (spec 3.7).

params.name: revision
params.description: Newest API revision the client speaks.

methods.name: hab.ping
methods.summary: Client liveness; send every 15 s when idle (spec 3.5).

methods.name: rpc.discover
methods.summary: The schema of this API. Its result is the schema document and carries no seq.

methods.name: structure.get
methods.summary: Read the whole structure of the host.

methods.name: events.subscribe
methods.summary: Snapshot the objects in scope and start events (spec 3.5).

methods.name: pane.input
methods.summary: Write bytes to a pane's program as one write (spec 3.8).

params.name: data
params.description: Bytes to write. Give data or text.

params.name: text
params.description: UTF-8 text to write. Give data or text.

methods.name: data.ticket
methods.summary: A single-use ticket, valid 30 s, to open a data connection (spec 5.2).

params.name: observe
params.description: Observer stream: never takes ownership (spec 6.4).

methods.name: pane.take
methods.summary: Become the pane's size owner now (spec 6.3).

methods.name: pane.request
methods.summary: Become the size owner only if the pane has none (spec 6.3).

methods.name: pane.disown
methods.summary: Give up size ownership; the pane keeps its size (spec 6.3).

methods.name: pane.set_desired_size
methods.summary: Store this client's wanted size (spec 6.3).

methods.name: pane.redraw
methods.summary: Send a fresh snapshot, or nudge the program to redraw (spec 6.7).

params.name: mode
params.description: Default snapshot.

methods.name: devices.pair
methods.summary: Make a one-time pairing offer for a new device (transport.md 6.1). Needs the devices capability.

params.name: label
params.description: Label for the device that will pair.

methods.name: devices.list
methods.summary: List the devices in the hab's trust store (transport.md 5). Needs the devices capability.

methods.name: devices.revoke
methods.summary: Revoke a device and close its connections (transport.md 6.6). Needs the devices capability.

params.name: id
params.description: Device id to revoke.

methods.name: session.create
methods.summary: Start a program in a new pane and file it as a session (spec 3.9).

params.name: argv
params.description: Program and arguments. Default: the hab's $SHELL, else /bin/sh.

params.name: cols
params.description: Initial width. Default 80.

params.name: cwd
params.description: Absolute working directory. Default: project_dir, else the most recently used folder of the project, else the hab's home directory.

params.name: cwd_of
params.description: A pane id: start in that pane's working folder (its program's, else the last one its shell reported with OSC 7, else where its session started) and file the session in that pane's project. Cwd and project_dir win over it.

params.name: env
params.description: KEY=value entries added to the hab's own environment; an entry replaces the hab's value for its key.

params.name: envelope
params.description: With group: what the group's confirmed plan allows. A later start from this member inside it asks nothing, and is a member too.

params.name: group
params.description: Only with trust_cover: the session is a member of this group.

params.name: harness
params.description: Detection manifest id of a harness to start, such as claude. Needs that harness's adapter.

params.name: idempotency_key
params.description: A key the client makes for this create, at most 128 bytes. A repeat with the same key gets the first create's ids and starts nothing.

params.name: model
params.description: With harness: the model to start it with, passed as --model. Needs the confirm capability.

params.name: name
params.description: Session name, unique on the host. Default: the program's base name, with -2, -3 and so on when taken.

params.name: project
params.description: Project id to file the session in. Give project or project_dir, or neither for an unfiled session.

params.name: project_dir
params.description: Absolute path inside a git repository. The hab finds the project by the repository's remote, else its root commit, and creates the project when it is new.

params.name: report_to
params.description: A session name on the calling hab: the hab at the other end of the peer link the call came over, else this one. The hab sends that session the final agent message of each turn of the new session that a message from it (or the seed) began, as a channel message from the new session. Needs harness and the confirm capability.

params.name: rows
params.description: Initial height. Default 24.

params.name: seed
params.description: The session's first message, at most 8000 characters. The hab delivers it once the agent can take it, marked as written by seed_from on the owner's behalf. Needs harness and the confirm capability.

params.name: seed_from
params.description: Who wrote the seed, as host/session, shown in its envelope.

params.name: trust_cover
params.description: Only from a hab over a peer link, or from this hab's own confirmations: the group whose confirmation answers the harness's folder trust prompt. The hab answers the prompt of the new pane itself when its folder is a worktree this hab made on a branch under branch_prefix, for the cover's harness; otherwise, or when the answer fails, the trust card shows as before.

methods.name: session.resume
methods.summary: Start an exited session's harness again in a new pane, with its resume id.

methods.name: session.adopt
methods.summary: Resume a Claude Code or Codex conversation started outside Flightdeck in a new pane, by its id; refused with conflict while it runs elsewhere (gff-client.md 6.5).

params.name: cwd
params.description: Absolute folder to resume in. Default: the folder the transcript records.

params.name: harness
params.description: claude or codex. Default: the harness whose transcripts hold the id.

params.name: id
params.description: The harness's own session id, as its resume command takes it: letters, digits, - and _.

params.name: name
params.description: Session name, unique on the host. Default: the harness name, with -2, -3 and so on when taken.

methods.name: session.outside
methods.summary: List recent conversations on this host that no session of the hab holds, newest first (gff-client.md 6.5). Read-only.

params.name: harness
params.description: claude or codex. Default: both.

params.name: limit
params.description: At most this many per harness; default 20, at most 100.

methods.name: pane.close
methods.summary: Release a pane: a running program gets a hang-up first (spec 3.9).

methods.name: session.rename
methods.summary: Give a session a new name. A name another session holds is refused with conflict.

params.name: name
params.description: The new name; unique among the host's sessions, exited ones included.

methods.name: session.close
methods.summary: Remove a session record. A live pane keeps running, unfiled; pane.close ends a program.

methods.name: session.focus
methods.summary: Report whether the session is in focus on this client: marks done seen, and holds pushes while watched.

params.name: active
params.description: True while the session is on screen in an active window.

methods.name: session.interrupt
methods.summary: Stop the agent's current turn through its adapter.

methods.name: session.send
methods.summary: Send a message to the session's agent through its adapter, under the input rules.

params.name: attachments
params.description: Attachment ids from attachment.put.

params.name: idempotency_key
params.description: A key the client makes for this message, at most 128 bytes. A repeat with the same key gets the first send's answer and writes nothing.

methods.name: approval.answer
methods.summary: Answer a pending request by id. A closed or expired id is refused with conflict.

params.name: choice
params.description: allow or deny a permission; answer a question with text.

params.name: request
params.description: The request id from the pane's agent state.

params.name: text
params.description: With choice answer: the chosen option or free text.

methods.name: trust.answer
methods.summary: Answer the pane's folder trust prompt from the dialog on screen; refused with conflict when it is gone. Needs the trust capability.

params.name: choice
params.description: trust the folder, or exit the harness as its own No, exit does.

methods.name: chat.page
methods.summary: Read a page of the session's chat messages from the transcript reader. Needs the transcripts capability.

params.name: after
params.description: A cursor from an earlier page: return the messages added or changed since it, oldest first. Not with before.

params.name: before
params.description: Message id: return the messages before it. Absent means the tail.

params.name: limit
params.description: Most messages to return. Default 50, at most 200.

methods.name: attachment.put
methods.summary: Start an upload of a file for a session; the bytes follow in attachment.write runs (app.md 4.4). Needs the attachments capability.

params.name: name
params.description: File name as the owner sees it.

params.name: sha256
params.description: Hex SHA-256 of the bytes.

params.name: size
params.description: Bytes.

params.name: type
params.description: Media type, such as image/png.

methods.name: attachment.write
methods.summary: Send the next run of an upload's bytes; the last run checks the hash and puts the file in place (app.md 4.4). Needs the attachments capability.

params.name: data
params.description: At most chunk bytes from attachment.put.

params.name: id
params.description: The id from attachment.put.

params.name: offset
params.description: Where data starts: the bytes received so far.

methods.name: attachment.get
methods.summary: Fetch a run of an attachment's bytes, or its thumbnail (app.md 4.4). Needs the attachments capability.

params.name: limit
params.description: Most bytes to return. Default 256 KiB, at most 1 MiB. Not with thumbnail.

params.name: offset
params.description: Where the run starts. Not with thumbnail.

params.name: thumbnail
params.description: Return a small preview image instead of the file.

methods.name: content.show
methods.summary: Store a reference to a file on the hab's host for a session to show (app.md 4.7). Needs the content capability.

params.name: kind
params.description: How to render it. Absent: from the file name.

params.name: pane_token
params.description: The token in the calling pane's GFF_HAB, instead of session: the hab finds the pane, then its session.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path of a regular file on the hab's host.

params.name: session
params.description: The session. Absent: pane_token names it.

params.name: title
params.description: Shown instead of the file name. At most 200 characters.

methods.name: content.list
methods.summary: The files a session showed or touched: shown files, images from tool calls and files it changed (app.md 4.7). Needs the content capability.

methods.name: content.read
methods.summary: Read a run of one listed file's bytes, in bounded chunks (app.md 4.7). Needs the content capability.

params.name: id
params.description: An item id from content.list for this session.

params.name: limit
params.description: Most bytes to return. Default 256 KiB, at most 1 MiB.

methods.name: content.diff
methods.summary: A listed file's diff in unified format (app.md 4.7). Needs the content capability.

methods.name: push.register
methods.summary: Store an APNs device token for this device. Needs the push capability.

params.name: device_id
params.description: The device's key fingerprint (transport.md 5).

params.name: features
params.description: Notification features the app registered. ask: the Ask categories (approval-ask, approval-deny-ask, open-ask, ask; capcom.md 8.5). Unknown words are kept and ignored.

params.name: hide_commands
params.description: True: banners say "Approval needed" with no command, and offer no Approve (app.md 16.1).

params.name: kinds
params.description: The kinds of push this device wants.

params.name: token
params.description: APNs device token, hex.

methods.name: push.register_activity
methods.summary: Store a Live Activity token for the session this device tracks. Needs the push capability.

params.name: token
params.description: Live Activity push token, hex.

methods.name: push.unregister
methods.summary: Drop a push token. Needs the push capability.

methods.name: notice.raise
methods.summary: Raise a Flightdeck notification: a notice.raised event to subscribers, and a push where push is set up.

params.name: body
params.description: Up to 16 words and 100 characters; shortened the same way.

params.name: level
params.description: Default active.

params.name: session
params.description: The session the notice is about: its project names the banner, and a client watching it gets no push.

params.name: title
params.description: Up to 8 words and 50 characters; a longer title is shortened with an ellipsis.

methods.name: usage.list
methods.summary: The latest usage reading of each harness account on this hab.

methods.name: hab.stats
methods.summary: CPU, memory, disk, battery and uptime of the host. Needs the host-stats capability.

methods.name: command.list
methods.summary: Read a page of a pane's shell commands, found by OSC 133 marks (spec 2.5). Needs the commands capability.

params.name: before
params.description: Command id: return the commands before it. Absent means the newest.

params.name: limit
params.description: Most commands to return. Default 100, at most 1000.

methods.name: command.output
methods.summary: Read a run of one command's output from the holder's ring (spec 2.5). Needs the commands capability.

params.name: command
params.description: Command id.

params.name: from
params.description: Offset to read from. Absent means the output's start.

params.name: limit
params.description: Most bytes to return. Default and most 1 MiB.

methods.name: peers.list
methods.summary: This hab's peers with their link state, and habs linked to it that it does not list (mesh.md 3, 4.3). Needs the mesh capability.

methods.name: peers.accept
methods.summary: Pin the device id a peer presented in place of the pinned one (transport.md 6.3). Needs the mesh capability.

params.name: label
params.description: The peer whose new device id to accept.

methods.name: catalog.get
methods.summary: This hab's own catalog, whole, when its generation differs from since (mesh.md 5.2). Needs the catalog capability.

params.name: since
params.description: The generation the caller holds; 0 for none.

methods.name: catalog.put
methods.summary: A peer link hands over its own hab's catalog (mesh.md 4.2). Needs the catalog capability.

params.name: catalog
params.description: The caller's own catalog. Its device_id must be the peer link's.

methods.name: catalog.list
methods.summary: The merged view: this hab's catalog and its direct peers' copies, with projects matched across hosts (mesh.md 5.2). Needs the catalog capability.

methods.name: hab.permissions
methods.summary: Check the permission grants of the holders, from a probe pane, and of gff-hab (macos-identity.md 7.2). Needs the permissions capability.

params.name: grants
params.description: Check only these grants (macos-identity.md 7.1 names, plus domain, background-item, signature, files-and-folders and pasteboard). Absent checks every grant.

params.name: request
params.description: Ask macOS for this one grant before the check, where an API can: accessibility, screen-recording, local-network, files-and-folders or pasteboard. It may show a dialog; only the setup walk sends it.

methods.name: speech.prepare
methods.summary: Load the speech engine now, and start the model download if needed; returns the engine state at once (voice.md). Needs the speech capability.

methods.name: speech.transcribe
methods.summary: Turn one recorded clip into text (voice.md). One decode at a time; others wait in order. Needs the speech capability.

params.name: audio
params.description: The clip, base64.

params.name: language
params.description: Default en, the only language this build transcribes.

params.name: sample_rate
params.description: Samples per second, for pcm16. Default 16000.

params.name: session
params.description: Apply this session's vocabulary (the file and folder names of its project, as git lists them) to the text.

methods.name: detect.explain
methods.summary: Say why a pane shows its agent state: the source that won, the process match and each screen rule's region and result (harness-adapters.md, Detection). Needs the detect-explain capability.

params.name: pane
params.description: Pane id. Give pane or session.

params.name: session
params.description: Session id or name; the session's live pane is explained.

methods.name: channel.send
methods.summary: Send a message from a session on this hab to an agent by address (mesh.md 6.5). Needs the channels capability.

params.name: from
params.description: The sending session on this hab: its name or its id. The hook endpoint fills it from the pane's token.

params.name: to
params.description: An address: label/name, or a bare name (mesh.md 6.5).

methods.name: channel.status
methods.summary: A sent message's record, optionally after waiting for its final state (mesh.md 6.5). Needs the channels capability.

params.name: wait_ms
params.description: Wait up to this long for a final state; 0 answers at once. At most 600000.

methods.name: channel.wait
methods.summary: Wait for a message to a session, or for an agent's state, or the end of the time (mesh.md 6.4). Needs the channels capability.

params.name: agent
params.description: Wait for this agent to reach a state in for: a name on this hab, or label/name or a bare name on a peer (mesh.md 6.6). The answer names it by its full address.

params.name: for
params.description: The states that end the wait for agent; empty means any change.

params.name: session
params.description: Wait for a message to this session on this hab. The hook endpoint fills it from the pane's token.

params.name: timeout_ms
params.description: Default 180000, at most 600000.

methods.name: mail.push
methods.summary: A peer link hands over outbox items for this hab; one result per item (mesh.md 6.5). Needs the channels capability.

params.name: items
params.description: In outbox order, at most 100.

methods.name: mail.pull
methods.summary: A peer link takes the outbox items waiting for its hab, and reports on its last pull (mesh.md 6.5). Needs the channels capability.

params.name: done
params.description: Results for the items of the caller's last pull; the hab removes them from its outbox.

methods.name: logbook.pull
methods.summary: A peer link takes one page of the Logbook ops its hab lacks by its version vector (logbook.md 7.1). Peer links only. Needs the logbook capability.

params.name: have
params.description: The caller's version vector. An origin it does not list counts as 0.

params.name: max_bytes
params.description: The most op bytes the answer may hold; one larger op still comes alone. 0, or above 1 MiB, means 1 MiB.

params.name: max_ops
params.description: The most ops the answer may hold. 0, or above 2,000, means 2,000.

params.name: skip
params.description: Origins the caller refuses (two hosts share them, logbook.md 7.4), or passes over in this exchange; none of their ops are sent.

methods.name: logbook.push
methods.summary: A peer link hands over one page of Logbook ops this hab lacks; the answer is this hab's version vector (logbook.md 7.1). Peer links only. Needs the logbook capability.

params.name: ops
params.description: Op bytes as stored, per origin in seq order: at most 2,000 ops or 1 MiB, or one larger op.

methods.name: worktree.list
methods.summary: List a repository's working trees, the main one first (spec 3.10).

params.name: project
params.description: Project id. The hab uses the project's most recently used folder on this host. Give project or project_dir.

params.name: project_dir
params.description: Absolute path inside a working tree of the repository. The hab finds or creates its project, as session.create does.

methods.name: worktree.create
methods.summary: Make a worktree, copy the files .worktreeinclude names, and start its setup script in a session (spec 3.10).

params.name: base
params.description: Where a new branch starts: a branch, remote branch, tag or commit. Default: the source checkout's HEAD. The hab never fetches.

params.name: branch
params.description: Branch to check out: a local branch, or a branch of exactly one remote when base is absent; otherwise a new branch from base. Absent: a new branch named wt/<word>-<word>-<hex>.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute folder for the worktree; it must not exist. Default: <worktree root>/<repository folder>/<branch slug>.

params.name: project
params.description: Project id. The hab uses the project's most recently used folder on this host. Give project or project_dir.

params.name: project_dir
params.description: Absolute path inside a working tree of the repository. The hab finds or creates its project, as session.create does.

params.name: setup
params.description: auto (default): run the setup script unless the code may come from someone else; run: run it anyway, after the user said yes; skip: do not run it.

methods.name: worktree.setup
methods.summary: Start a worktree's setup script in a session now: the yes to a pending setup, or a rerun (spec 3.10).

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute folder of a linked worktree of the repository.

params.name: project
params.description: Project id. The hab uses the project's most recently used folder on this host. Give project or project_dir.

params.name: project_dir
params.description: Absolute path inside a working tree of the repository. The hab finds or creates its project, as session.create does.

methods.name: settings.get
methods.summary: Read every hab-side setting, or the named ones (app.md 20.5). Needs the settings capability.

params.name: ids
params.description: The settings to read. Absent: every hab-side setting. An id this hab does not know is left out of the result.

methods.name: settings.set
methods.summary: Write hab-side settings, all or nothing, each with the revision last seen (app.md 20.5). Needs the settings capability.

params.name: values
params.description: Rows to write, all or nothing. Any refused row refuses the call; error.data.id names the first refused row.

methods.name: capcom.open
methods.summary: Return the standing Capcom session on this home host, starting or resuming it as needed; new starts a fresh one (capcom.md 7.2). Needs the capcom capability.

params.name: context
params.description: Context to attach to the returned session's next message, in order, as capcom.attach takes it (capcom.md 8.1). A refused item fails the call; items checked before the open fail it before any start. A file names an attachment of the returned session, or a path under its folder.

params.name: new
params.description: Start a fresh Capcom session in a new folder; the standing one stays resumable.

methods.name: capcom.attach
methods.summary: Attach context to a Capcom session's next message: a notification, a session, a file, a console command or a Logbook record. The hab resolves the ref at once and delivers it as a block before the user's text at the next session.send, then drops it; at most 8 items wait, and the same item twice is kept once (capcom.md 8.1). Needs the capcom capability.

params.name: host
params.description: As in CapcomContextRef.

params.name: ref
params.description: As in CapcomContextRef.

params.name: session
params.description: A Capcom session on this hab.

methods.name: capcom.detach
methods.summary: Remove one item from the context waiting for a Capcom session's next message, and return what still waits; an item that does not wait answers not_found (capcom.md 8.4). Needs the capcom capability.

params.name: host
params.description: As attached, or the item's host label. Absent: this hab.

params.name: ref
params.description: As attached.

params.name: session
params.description: A Capcom session on this hab.

methods.name: capcom.pending
methods.summary: Read the context waiting for a Capcom session's next message, in delivery order. Read-only: it starts, resumes and changes nothing (capcom.md 8.4). Needs the capcom capability.

params.name: session
params.description: A Capcom session on this hab.

methods.name: capcom.assign
methods.summary: Make a host the Capcom home host, with a counter above every one seen (capcom.md 7.3). Needs the capcom capability.

params.name: assignment
params.description: The lowest counter to use. A hab that forwards an assignment to the chosen peer sends one above every counter it has seen.

params.name: host
params.description: self, a peer label from this hab's peer list, or a device id.

methods.name: capcom.thread.page
methods.summary: A page of the Capcom thread, newest first, folded: at most 200 items (capcom-service.md 7.4). Needs the capcom-thread capability.

params.name: before
params.description: An item id: items older than it. Absent: the newest.

params.name: limit
params.description: At most this many, and never more than 200. 0: 200.

methods.name: capcom.interrupt
methods.summary: Stop the Capcom engine's current turn; messages it has not taken wait for the next turn. unavailable when the engine lacks interrupt or none is connected (capcom-service.md 7.4). Needs the capcom-thread capability.

methods.name: capcom.status
methods.summary: The Capcom service on this hab: the engine job's state, the engine, and the SDK sessions with the engine's folder (capcom-service.md 3.4, 11). Needs the capcom-thread capability.

methods.name: capcom.pause
methods.summary: Finish the turn, then stop the engine's use of its SDK session until capcom.resume, so a plain terminal can resume it; the thread still takes messages (capcom-service.md 11). Needs the capcom-thread capability.

methods.name: capcom.resume
methods.summary: Clear a pause, the crash count and a stop after refused credentials, read the credential again, and start the engine (capcom-service.md 3.2, 10.2, 11). Needs the capcom-thread capability.

methods.name: capcom.card.answer
methods.summary: Answer a card of the Capcom thread with one of its choices; the first answer wins and a later one answers conflict. A memory line's undo deletes the capcom guide it names, or rejects its proposal while it waits for review (capcom-service.md 6.4, 7.4). Needs the capcom-thread capability.

params.name: choice
params.description: One of the card's choices. A memory line's undo deletes the capcom guide it names, or rejects the proposal while it waits for review (capcom-service.md 6.4).

params.name: item
params.description: The card's item id.

methods.name: worktree.remove
methods.summary: Run the teardown script, then remove a linked worktree; its branch stays. Uncommitted changes need force (spec 3.10).

params.name: force
params.description: Remove it even with uncommitted or untracked changes, which are lost. The client confirms with the user first.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute folder of a linked worktree of the repository.

params.name: project
params.description: Project id. The hab uses the project's most recently used folder on this host. Give project or project_dir.

params.name: project_dir
params.description: Absolute path inside a working tree of the repository. The hab finds or creates its project, as session.create does.

methods.name: transcript.list
methods.summary: Past and current harness sessions from their native transcripts, newest first, on every host or one (capcom.md 4). Needs the read-tools capability.

params.name: harness
params.description: claude or codex.

params.name: host
params.description: A peer label or device id, this hab's host id or device id, or self. Absent: every host.

params.name: limit
params.description: Most sessions to return. Default 50, at most 200.

params.name: project
params.description: A project name, or a folder: sessions in it or under it.

params.name: since
params.description: RFC 3339 time: sessions written to at or after it.

params.name: until
params.description: RFC 3339 time: sessions started before it.

methods.name: transcript.search
methods.summary: Search past transcripts by words, newest first, at most 50 hits and 5 s per host; partial and offline hosts marked (capcom.md 4). Needs the read-tools capability.

params.name: harness
params.description: claude or codex.

params.name: host
params.description: A peer label or device id, this hab's host id or device id, or self. Absent: every host.

params.name: limit
params.description: Most hits to return. Default 50, at most 50.

params.name: project
params.description: A project name, or a folder.

params.name: since
params.description: RFC 3339 time: transcripts written to at or after it.

params.name: words
params.description: Words that must all appear in a message, any case. Double quotes keep a phrase together.

methods.name: transcript.read

report_to.description: A session name on the calling hab: the hab at the other end of the peer link the call came over, else this one. The hab sends that session the final agent message of each turn of the new session that a message from it (or the seed) began, as a channel message from the new session. Needs harness and the confirm capability.

seed.description: The session's first message, at most 8000 characters. The hab delivers it once the agent can take it, marked as written by seed_from on the owner's behalf. Needs harness and the confirm capability.

seed_from.description: Who wrote the seed, as host/session, shown in its envelope.

trust_cover.description: Only from a hab over a peer link, or from this hab's own confirmations: the group whose confirmation answers the harness's folder trust prompt. The hab answers the prompt of the new pane itself when its folder is a worktree this hab made on a branch under branch_prefix, for the cover's harness; otherwise, or when the answer fails, the trust card shows as before.
